description: Defines the SettingsTab view for the iOS app, implementing the user interface and logic for app settings, gateway configurations, and device features in the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: SwiftUI View for app settings, gateway management, and device options, encapsulating all user interface elements and logic associated with the configuration screen.

classes.name: FeatureHelp
classes.description: Struct representing contextual help information for features within the SettingsTab view.

methods.name: gatewayList
methods.description: Displays list of available or connected gateways based on mode.

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: Creates a toggle UI element with an info button and optional help message.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to a specified discovered gateway.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to the last known gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates debug information about gateway status and logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Builds the UI label for the last known gateway button.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the manual port text representation with the current port number.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Applies a setup code received from the user and attempts to connect using provided details.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a gateway setup code to configure connection parameters.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL from setup code and sets connection parameters accordingly.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the port to use based on manual gateway settings and host.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Performs a TCP reachability check to the gateway host and port before connection.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Static method to probe TCP connection with timeout for reachability.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect manually using host, port, and TLS settings.

methods.name: setupStatusLine
methods.description: Provides a human-readable status message for gateway setup process.

methods.name: tailnetWarningText
methods.description: Warns if the gateway is on your tailnet and Tailscale is off.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Provides user-friendly messages based on gateway status error strings.

methods.name: hasTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if any network interface has a tailnet IP address.

methods.name: isTailnetHostOrIP
methods.description: Determines if a hostname or IP belongs to your tailnet.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address belongs to the tailnet range.

methods.name: parseHostPort
methods.description: Parses a host and port from a given address string.

methods.name: httpURLString
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string based on host and port, with fallback.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, disconnects gateway, and clears stored credentials.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Returns descriptive lines about a discovered gateway for display.
